name: Apostle Islands Ice Caves
unique: In rare cold winters, Lake Superior freezes solid enough to walk to sea caves hung with curtains of blue ice, a phenomenon that may not happen at all in a given year.
buzz: When it opens, it is one of the most spectacular things in the Midwest; check the park's ice report before driving. Never go alone.

name: EAA AirVenture
unique: Ten thousand aircraft and 600,000 people descend on a regional airport for a week of airshows, homebuilts, warbirds and a night show with fireworks.
buzz: Even casual visitors are stunned; bring earplugs and comfortable shoes. Lodging books a year out.

name: House on the Rock
unique: A fever dream house built over a chimney, with the world's largest carousel, a sea monster, automated orchestras and a bookcase that opens into a tunnel.
buzz: People either call it a masterpiece of outsider art or a hoarder's monument; both are right. Allow three hours minimum.

name: Devil's Lake
unique: A spring fed lake between two quartzite bluffs, with a balanced rock trail, purple quartzite cliffs and some of the best top rope climbing in the Midwest.
buzz: The bluff trails are crowded on summer weekends; go at sunrise and swim after. The East Bluff is the classic loop.

name: Milwaukee Art Museum
unique: A museum with a winged addition by Calatrava that opens and closes over the lake, plus a strong American and folk art collection.
buzz: The wings opening is the photo, and the collection is solid. Check the schedule for the brise soleil.

name: Door County
unique: A peninsula of cherry orchards, fish boils, lighthouses and limestone cliffs, with a shoreline that feels like Maine and a pace that feels like 1955.
buzz: The fish boil at a Scandinavian restaurant is the ritual; book a cottage months ahead for fall color.

name: Taliesin
unique: Wright's own home and studio, built into a Wisconsin hillside with the roof lines following the ridge, rebuilt twice after fires.
buzz: The house tour is excellent and the estate walk is worth the extra; photography rules are strict. Pair with House on the Rock for whiplash.

name: Lambeau Field
unique: The only community owned team in major American sports, with a stadium tour that includes the tunnel, the frozen tundra and a hall of fame.
buzz: The tour is excellent even for nonfans; game day tickets require a season ticket waiting list or luck.

name: Olbrich Botanical Gardens
unique: Sixteen acres of gardens with a Thai pavilion, a rose garden, a prairie and a conservatory.
buzz: The Thai pavilion is the photo and the outdoor gardens are free. Quiet and pretty.

name: Peninsula State Park
unique: A 3,700 acre park on Green Bay with a lighthouse, a beach, bike trails and a view of the Door County islands.
buzz: The Eagle Bluff lighthouse and the bike loop are the highlights. Book camping early in summer.

name: Summerfest
unique: Eleven stages on the Lake Michigan shore for eleven days, with a giant American flag, fried cheese and a lineup that runs from hip hop to polka.
buzz: It is cheap for a major festival and the lake breeze saves it; headliners cost extra. Bring a blanket and pace yourself.

name: Wingspread
unique: A late Frank Lloyd Wright house with a four winged plan around a central great hall, built for the Johnson wax family.
buzz: For Wright fans it is a major house, and the great hall is the showpiece. Tours by reservation.

name: Forevertron
unique: The largest scrap metal sculpture in the world, a 300 ton time machine built from industrial salvage by a former junkyard artist, surrounded by giant birds and a teapot orchestra.
buzz: It is free, enormous and completely unexpected; photographers love it at sunset. A ten minute detour off the interstate.

name: Circus World Museum
unique: The winter quarters of the Ringling brothers, with circus wagons, a big top and daily performances in summer.
buzz: The wagon collection is enormous and the shows are real. Good for kids and nostalgia.

name: Harley-Davidson Museum
unique: The archive of an American icon: prototype engines, a wall of gas tanks, the first serial number bike and a room of custom choppers.
buzz: Even nonriders enjoy the design story; the factory tour in Menomonee Falls is a separate booking.

name: Cave of the Mounds
unique: A limestone cave with colorful mineral formations, a guided tour and a fossil dig outside.
buzz: The formations are colorful and the tour is easy. A good rainy day stop with kids.

name: Wisconsin State Fair
unique: A state fair famous for cream puffs, cheese, livestock shows and a midway, eleven days in August.
buzz: The cream puffs are the ritual and the livestock barns are the real fair. Go on a weekday.

name: Miller Brewery Tour
unique: A tour of the old Miller brewery with the caves, the brewhouse and a tasting at the end.
buzz: The caves and the history are the interesting parts, and the tasting is generous. Book ahead.

name: Wisconsin Dells Duck Boats
unique: A WWII amphibious vehicle drives straight from the street into the Wisconsin River and up a sandstone gorge, with a driver who tells terrible jokes.
buzz: It is exactly as silly as it sounds and kids love it; the Dells is a waterpark town with a strange natural core.
